definitions.full: H4652. miphlaah [ מִפְלָאָה ] noun feminine wondrous work (si vera lectio); — plural construct מִפְלְאוֺת Job 37:16 (of providence; but read probably נִפְלְאוֺת Bu SS, compare Di).
